cohort: 964 neonates admitted to neonatal intensive care unit of a University Teaching and Referral Hospital from 2015 to 2017
finding: Neonatal mortality was high (27 per 1000 neonate-days) and associated with multiple birth, lack of antenatal care, cesarean delivery, delayed breastfeeding initiation, resuscitation, hyaline membrane disease, and perinatal asphyxia.
mod_finding: Neonates born by cesarean section were more likely to die within the first four weeks of life.
